# @arki/queue

> Typed background jobs for TypeScript, inspired by tRPC. Jobs, schedules and flows run on BullMQ and Redis. A second lane, `@arki/queue/outbox`, writes a job as a database row in your transaction and runs it from the `@arki/journal` worker.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/queue`: Typed background jobs, schedules and flows on BullMQ and Redis. `BullMQAdapter`, `ConsoleLogger`, `CronPatterns`, `FLOW_ENQUEUE_FAILURES`, `HonoAdapter`, `JOB_SYSTEM_FAILURES`, `JOB_TRIGGER_FAILURES`, `JobError`, `JobValidationError`, `PerformanceTracker`, `QUEUE_DEFINITION_ERROR_CODES`, `QUEUE_INPUT_ERROR_CODES`; and 60 more.
- `@arki/queue/types`: The types of the queue core, without the runtime. `QUEUE_PRIORITIES`; types `BullMQQueueInstance`, `ComputeFinalContext`, `DataTransformer`, `ErrorFormatter`, `FlowBuilderFactory`, `FlowBuilderNeedsStep`, `FlowBuilderStart`, `FlowBuilderWithInput`, `FlowDefinition`, `FlowEnqueueResult`, `FlowStepOptions`; and 29 more.
- `@arki/queue/runtime-local`: The queue on pg-boss and PGlite, with no Redis. `createRuntimeLocalQueueInstance`, `initQueue`; types `RuntimeLocalQueueInstanceOptions`.
- `@arki/queue/dot`: @arki/queue in a Dot app: the queue client, the worker, and the job slices. `DURABLE_SCHEDULES_KEY`, `QUEUE_ACTION_META_SCHEMA`, `QUEUE_PLUGIN_ERROR_CODES`, `durableScheduler`, `jobProducers`, `jobs`, `outboxJobs`, `outboxPlugin`, `outboxProducers`, `queue`, `queueActions`, `queueConsumerActions`; and 18 more.
- `@arki/queue/outbox`: transactional scheduling. `OUTBOX_ERROR_CODES`, `isOutboxError`, `outbox`, `outboxRunner`; types `Outbox`, `OutboxError`, `OutboxErrorCode`, `OutboxOptions`, `OutboxRunnerOptions`, `OutboxTx`, `QueueRegistry`, `ScheduleOptions`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/queue/projection`: `project`; types `QueueTopologyDocument`.
- `@arki/queue/foreman`: The Foreman admin module for queues. `QUEUE_FOREMAN_ERROR_CODES`, `bullmqFailedJobSource`, `failedJobSchema`, `pgBossFailedJobSource`, `queueForemanModule`, `redactSecrets`; types `BullMQFailedJobSourceOptions`, `FailedJobRecord`, `FailedJobSource`, `PgBossFailedJobSourceOptions`, `QueueForemanErrorCode`, `QueueForemanOptions`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Files
- Definitions: `src/init.ts` (`initQueue`), `src/middleware.ts` (the middleware chain), `src/types/job.ts` (`JobDefinition`, `JobContext`, `JobLike`, `QUEUE_PRIORITIES`).
- Outbox: `src/outbox/outbox.ts` (`outbox`, `runAfter`, `runAt`, `cancel`), `src/outbox/runner.ts` (`outboxRunner`), `src/outbox/errors.ts` (the seven codes), `src/outbox/registry.ts` (`QueueRegistry`).
- Edges: `src/dot.ts` (Dot adapters), `src/runtime-local/` (pg-boss), `src/foreman/` (admin module), `src/projection.ts`.

## Rules that bite
- A job can run more than once. Pass `ctx.job.id` to external systems as the idempotency key.
- A job name is its queue name. Use dots, never a colon (BullMQ refuses `:`).
- Version job names (`mail.welcome.v1`). A worker only claims names its registry knows.
- `trigger()` and `enqueue()` return an id or a failure. After `QueueAcceptanceUnknown`, look the job up by its key before you send it again.
- `runAfter(tx, job, args)` takes a transaction, never the root database.
- Outbox args are stored as plain JSON.
